reserveReview.rationale: MCCPA's independent performance attestation report, dated October 13, 2026, examines Brale's assertion as of September 30, 2026 at 11:50 PM Eastern. It records $20,185,277 of cash and cash equivalents and $1,408,578 of U.S. government-backed debt against 21,593,854 SBC issued across all thirty named supported blockchains. The printed reserve total is $21,593,854 while the two rounded categories sum to $21,593,855; composition is normalized to the category sum, producing 93.476950% cash and 6.523050% government-backed debt without changing either published amount. The unmodified AICPA direct-examination opinion states the assertion is fairly stated in all material respects. MCCPA relied on company-provided records without independently confirming their authenticity. Accounts are described as unencumbered and segregated from Brale's other accounts; banks, instrument identifiers, account withdrawal terms, debt maturities and provider allocations remain undisclosed.
